name: The Temple of St. Rylan is built
description: About 400 years ago, in the style of the IIIrd Emperor.

name: Archmage Hann takes two spheres
description: 33 years ago. He takes the [[Red Sphere]] and the [[Yellow Sphere]], leaves a note promising their return, and seals the Thing in the tavern cellar. The Empire's decline starts about now; with those two gone, anger and fear have had their magic back since.

name: Marcos researches the spheres
description: Over years, Marcos finds the clues proving the spheres exist, and works out the paths to the temple. He writes the letter and annotates the map.

name: The death of Marcos
description: Too old, as he says himself, to walk the paths he found.

name: The reading of Marcos's will
description: Each PC receives the same letter and annotated map. [[pc/greg-sayers|Greg Sayers]], who wrote the will out for Marcos, brought it to them.

name: The Autumn Equinox
description: The temple doors open at dawn (6am) and close 24 hours later. A week after the party sets out from the fork (in Cairn 2e; the booklet has two days).

name: Siofra rides on north
description: The party took the old road from [[place/the-fork|the Fork]] straight to the [[place/bridge-of-saints|Bridge of Saints]]. [[pc/siofra|Siofra]], on [[creature/lasarine|Lasarine]], had already gone on north into the distance, up the old road towards the [[place/rising-sun-tavern|Rising Sun]], by the time the goblins came. The party is split.

name: The goblins are sent downriver
description: The ruined village at the bridge lay under mist, suspiciously empty. A goblin turned up in the middle of it; the party offered it food. More goblins came, and began threatening them. [[pc/blindy|Blindy]] made them believe ([[rule/core-rules-saves|a WIL save]], passed) that their god [[npc/goblob|Goblob]], the Best Goblin, carved over the statue of [[npc/st-rylan|St. Rylan]], had sent word of food further down the river, and they all ran off to get it. No fight; the party kept everything they had. Where the first session ended.

name: Greg Sayers finds The Suppression of Magic
description: Scribing at [[place/island-monastery|the island monastery]], [[pc/greg-sayers|Greg Sayers]] finds [[document/the-suppression-of-magic|The Suppression of Magic]], and in it the Seven Silver Spheres.

name: Greg Sayers tells Marcos of the spheres
description: [[pc/greg-sayers|Greg Sayers]] meets [[npc/marcos|Marcos]] and talks with him about the spheres, passing on what he learned from [[document/the-suppression-of-magic|The Suppression of Magic]]: part of what went into [[event/marcos-research|Marcos's research]].

name: Blindy obtains the map
description: [[pc/blindy|Blindy]] obtains for [[npc/marcos|Marcos]] the map he went on to annotate ([[document/marcos-map|Marcos's Annotated Map]]), by means she has never explained. **Secret:** known only to Blindy (and the Warden).

name: Siofra guards Marcos
description: [[pc/siofra|Siofra]] rides as [[npc/marcos|Marcos]]'s guard as he travels the region. It gives her some insight into his studies and discoveries; how much is not yet known.
